# tools/migrate_cli.py
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import shutil
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OLD_DIR = ROOT / "app" / "material_engine" / "cli"
NEW_CLI = ROOT / "phs" / "cli.py"
REPORT = ROOT / "docs" / "cli_migration_report.md"
START = "# --- PHS LEGACY CLI MIGRATION START ---"
END = "# --- PHS LEGACY CLI MIGRATION END ---"


@dataclass
class CliMap:
    version: str
    old_file: Path
    old_module: str
    old_command: str
    new_command: str
    subcommand: str


def derive_subcommand(stem: str) -> str:
    name = re.sub(r"^foundry_v(0[4-9]|10)_?", "", stem)
    if not name or name == stem:
        name = "legacy"

    rules = [
        ("watermark", "watermark run"),
        ("dedup", "assets dedup"),
        ("vsc", "assets dedup"),
        ("import", "assets import"),
        ("ingest", "assets import"),
        ("asset", "assets"),
        ("material", "assets"),
        ("loop", "loop compile"),
        ("compile", "loop compile"),
        ("tts", "tts run"),
        ("cosy", "tts run"),
        ("obs", "obs run"),
        ("stream", "stream run"),
        ("bench", "bench run"),
        ("report", "report"),
        ("dashboard", "dashboard"),
        ("project", "project"),
    ]
    low = name.lower()
    for key, cmd in rules:
        if key in low:
            return cmd
    return name.replace("_", "-")


def scan_old_entries(old_dir: Path, new_prefix: str) -> List[CliMap]:
    if not old_dir.exists():
        return []

    items: List[CliMap] = []
    pattern = re.compile(r"foundry_v(0[4-9]|10).*\.py$", re.I)

    for py in sorted(old_dir.rglob("*.py")):
        if py.name.startswith("__"):
            continue
        if not pattern.match(py.name):
            continue

        rel = py.relative_to(ROOT).with_suffix("")
        module = ".".join(rel.parts)
        m = re.search(r"foundry_v(0[4-9]|10)", py.stem, re.I)
        version = f"v{m.group(1)}" if m else "unknown"
        subcommand = derive_subcommand(py.stem)

        items.append(
            CliMap(
                version=version,
                old_file=py,
                old_module=module,
                old_command=f"python -m {module}",
                new_command=f"{new_prefix} {subcommand}",
                subcommand=subcommand,
            )
        )
    return items


def render_report(items: List[CliMap], applied: bool) -> str:
    rows = [
        "| 版本 | 旧入口文件 | 旧命令 | 新命令 |",
        "|---|---|---|---|",
    ]
    for x in items:
        rows.append(
            f"| {x.version} | `{x.old_file.relative_to(ROOT)}` | "
            f"`{x.old_command}` | `{x.new_command}` |"
        )

    if not items:
        rows.append("| - | - | - | 未发现 foundry_v04~v10 旧入口 |")

    return f"""# PHS旧CLI入口迁移报告

- 生成时间：{datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")}
- 扫描目录：`{OLD_DIR.relative_to(ROOT)}`
- 新入口：`{NEW_CLI.relative_to(ROOT)}`
- 模式：{"apply，已写入 phs/cli.py" if applied else "dry-run，仅预览"}
- 旧入口数量：{len(items)}

## 迁移对照表

{chr(10).join(rows)}

## 迁移说明

- 旧入口范围：`foundry_v04` 到 `foundry_v10`。
- 新入口统一收敛到：`python -m phs.cli <subcommand>`。
- `--apply` 会备份原 `phs/cli.py`，然后写入兼容入口。
- 旧命令不直接删除，建议后续在文档中标记为 legacy。
"""


def render_cli(items: List[CliMap]) -> str:
    mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for x in items:
        mapping[x.old_module] = x.new_command
        mapping[x.old_file.name] = x.new_command
        mapping[x.old_file.stem] = x.new_command

    return f'''# phs/cli.py
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from typing import Dict, List


{START}
LEGACY_CLI_MAP: Dict[str, str] = {json.dumps(mapping, ensure_ascii=False, indent=4)}
{END}


def _print_legacy() -> None:
    if not LEGACY_CLI_MAP:
        print("No legacy foundry_v04~v10 CLI entries registered.")
        return
    print("Legacy CLI migration map:")
    for old, new in sorted(LEGACY_CLI_MAP.items()):
        print(f"  {{old}} -> {{new}}")


def main(argv: List[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="phs", description="PHS unified CLI entry")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd")

    sub.add_parser("legacy-map", help="show foundry_v04~v10 migration map")
    for name in ("assets", "watermark", "loop", "tts", "obs", "stream", "bench", "report", "dashboard", "project"):
        p = sub.add_parser(name)
        p.add_argument("args", nargs="*")

    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    if args.cmd == "legacy-map":
        _print_legacy()
        return 0

    if args.cmd:
        print(f"PHS CLI entry received: {{args.cmd}} {{' '.join(getattr(args, 'args', []))}}")
        print("Wire this subcommand to the corresponding phs engine/provider module.")
        return 0

    parser.print_help()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
'''


def apply_cli(items: List[CliMap], cli_path: Path) -> None:
    cli_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if cli_path.exists():
        backup = cli_path.with_suffix(f".bak.{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}.py")
        shutil.copy2(cli_path, backup)

    cli_path.write_text(render_cli(items), encoding="utf-8")


def write_report(items: List[CliMap], applied: bool, report_path: Path) -> None:
    report_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    report_path.write_text(render_report(items, applied), encoding="utf-8")


def print_preview(items: List[CliMap]) -> None:
    print(render_report(items, applied=False))


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Migrate old foundry_v04~v10 CLI entries to phs/cli.py")
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="preview migration only")
    mode.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true", help="write phs/cli.py and report")
    parser.add_argument("--old-dir", default=str(OLD_DIR), help="old CLI directory")
    parser.add_argument("--new-cli", default=str(NEW_CLI), help="new phs cli path")
    parser.add_argument("--report", default=str(REPORT), help="markdown report path")
    parser.add_argument("--new-prefix", default="python -m phs.cli", help="new command prefix")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    items = scan_old_entries(Path(args.old_dir), args.new_prefix)

    if args.apply:
        apply_cli(items, Path(args.new_cli))
        write_report(items, True, Path(args.report))
        print(f"Applied. Report: {args.report}")
    else:
        print_preview(items)
        write_report(items, False, Path(args.report))
        print(f"Dry-run report: {args.report}")

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
